ModMetaData.name: RimTalk Distance Control
ModMetaData.author: Community
ModMetaData.description:
Allows customization of RimTalk's distance and range limits for pawn conversations.
Features: - Adjust maximum conversation distance between pawns (default: 20) - Toggle same-room requirement for conversations - Adjust hearing and viewing detection ranges - Adjust environment context collection distance - Relax click-to-talk reachability check
Requires RimTalk mod to be installed.
